claims: Continue targeted temperature management at 37°C per Arctic Sun settings and monitor core temperature closely.
Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings (APV-CMV, tidal volume 450 mL, PEEP 5 cmH2O, FiO2 50%) and monitor airway pressures and minute volume.
Continue sedation with propofol and fentanyl infusions, titrating to goal RASS -5, and reassess sedation depth.
Monitor arterial blood gas and lactate; repeat ABG to assess oxygenation and ventilation given prior pO2 64 mmHg on FiO2 50%.
Monitor coagulation parameters (PTT 94.5 s, INR 1.5) and heparin infusion; adjust heparin per protocol.
Monitor blood glucose and continue insulin/dextrose management per sliding scale, given fingerstick glucose 114-148 mg/dL.
Monitor and replace electrolytes (potassium 3.7 mEq/L, magnesium 2.2 mg/dL, phosphate 3.6 mg/dL) per protocol.
Continue stress ulcer prophylaxis with famotidine and assess GI tolerance.
Continue antimicrobial therapy (cefepime, vancomycin, metronidazole, ceftazidime) and monitor for infection, given leukocytosis and sputum specimen.
Perform endotracheal tube care including subglottal suctioning, cuff pressure monitoring, and repositioning to prevent complications.
